notes.title: New Flying Ant Aiming System
notes.content:
[h1]What is it about?[/h1]
One of the most important mechanism is that ant nest can [b]spread/reproduce by send flying ant[/b].

[h2]Old System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44071134/d0d3e3b7c70f0176f7e592f497b1d3e55250ddac.png[/img]


The old flying ant aim system is, player can only control rotation, by rotate the area, the direction can be changed.
But sometimes it just hard to control, and a bit rely a random chance. So, I want to change it.


[h2]New System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44071134/aced613ab1e1a86949b489e76736e225e050713b.png[/img]


Introducing.....Drag Button...!?
Instead of only control the direction, [b]player can specifically choose a point on the map[/b] (within the range, of course).
And, the flying ant will randomly choose nearby to fly to. (The blue transparent area)

About the upgrade:
Fly Range, will effect how far can the button be placed.
Aim Range, will affect how small the area around the button, the smaller the better. (More precise)

[h2]What does it mean?[/h2]
It means.....that I need more play testing. XD
